title: HeroContent
description: Hero content: an optional badge, the heading, a description, one picture (light, optional dark) and up to two actions (the first drawn as the primary button, the second as the secondary one). One object is valid in every hero layout (media at the end, at the start, on top).

badge.description: a short pill above the heading; empty: no badge

description.description: one paragraph under the heading; empty: none

image.description: address of the picture (an https URL or a path); none: the placeholder

imageAlt.description: alt text of the picture; none: the title (the placeholder is decorative)

imageDark.description: address of the picture in the dark theme; none: image

actionLabel.description: the label of the action; the link is drawn when the label and the address are both set

secondaryActionLabel.description: the label of the second action (the secondary button after the first); drawn when the label and the address are both set; empty: none

secondaryActionHref.description: the address of the second action
